summary: This Form 6-K filing by Grupo Aval Acciones y Valores S.A., a Colombian foreign private issuer, merely announces the availability of materials for its quarterly consolidated results as of March 31, 2026, and an upcoming conference call. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine periodic report, not a material definitive agreement. Therefore, it does not qualify as a special situation under the specified categories.
